recommendations.title: Table labels are leans, not day calls; Low labels are now shown in grey
recommendations.evidence: Out of sample (walk-forward, every day 2013-2026: S&P and Sensex labels from rules picked on 2000-2013 only; gold and silver with their data-picked parts re-picked on 2000-2013): S&P Low 46.8% right vs 50.1% by chance, Moderate or High 55.5% vs 53.9% (p 0.3945), all labels 52.4% vs 52.5%; Sensex Low 45.4% right vs 50.2% by chance, Moderate or High 53.2% vs 53.3% (p 0.9724), all labels 50.5% vs 52.2%; Gold Low 47.9% right vs 49.6% by chance, Moderate or High 54.9% vs 51.1% (p 0.1693), all labels 50.0% vs 50.1%; Silver Low 53.9% right vs 51.7% by chance, Moderate or High 52.6% vs 52.2% (p 0.7992), all labels 53.3% vs 51.9%. Pooled edge: Low -0.9 points, Moderate or High +1.0 points; no strength beats chance in any market. The good figures in the published table (S&P Moderate or High 53.9% vs 49.8%, Sensex 54.6% vs 50.1%) come from choosing and scoring the rules on the same years.
recommendations.november: S&P 4 of 10; Sensex 8 of 10; Gold 5 of 10; Silver 4 of 9 (Low labels: S&P 2 of 6; Sensex 5 of 6; Gold 4 of 8)

recommendations.title: Combined model: its probabilities stay, but they are no longer coloured as calls
recommendations.evidence: Walk-forward 2013-2026 (fitted on earlier years; S&P and Sensex also with labels from rules picked on 2000-2013): S&P 50.7% right vs 49.8% by chance (p 0.5807, 1012 calls); Sensex 51.3% right vs 51.6% by chance (p 0.8515, 897 calls); Gold 47.1% right vs 49.8% by chance (p 0.2617, 425 calls); Silver 52.8% right vs 50.6% by chance (p 0.3975, 407 calls). Up calls look right more often only because markets rise more often: S&P up 57.3% vs 57.0%, down 43.5% vs 42.7%; Sensex up 58.6% vs 55.8%, down 48.0% vs 44.2%; Gold up 55.8% vs 53.0%, down 38.0% vs 46.5%; Silver up 51.8% vs 51.7%, down 54.7% vs 48.7%. Model v1.0 (gold, a source model, 2000-2026): 53.8% vs 53.6% (p 0.868).
recommendations.november: S&P 4 of 8; Sensex 4 of 5; Gold 1 of 1; Model v1.0 Gold 4 of 13

recommendations.title: Big days: only Venus retrograde (S&P and Sensex) and Jupiter-Pluto 5/9 (S&P) pass a clean test; the other volatility factors are in sample only, and the model's big-day chance is shown as untested
recommendations.evidence: Walk-forward 2013-2026, days the model flags (2+ points above normal) vs other days: S&P big on 4.7% vs 5.3% (p 0.5049, 870 flagged days); Sensex big on 7.3% vs 3.1% (p 0.0, 908 flagged days); Gold big on 3.9% vs 6.5% (p 0.0873, 282 flagged days); Silver never flags a day. The volatility factors on their own: S&P 2000-2012: 12.0% big on factor days vs 8.9% (p 0.0033); S&P 2013-2026: 6.4% big on factor days vs 4.2% (p 0.004); Sensex 2000-2012: 22.8% big on factor days vs 13.2% (p 0.0); Sensex 2013-2026: 7.3% big on factor days vs 2.6% (p 0.0). Clean test (tools/bigday_clean_test.py: the same choice made on 2000-2013 only, scored 2013-2026): S&P picks Venus retrograde, Jupiter-Pluto 5/9; 44 big days vs 31.0 expected (x1.42, p 0.0163; without Feb-May 2020 x1.6, p 0.0024; without 2025 x1.25, p 0.1158). Sensex: nothing is picked by 2013, but the S&P's two factors lift Sensex big days x1.5 (p 0.0113). Gold x0.68, silver x0.88: no.
recommendations.november: S&P 5 big days, 0 flagged by the model, 2 on volatility-factor days (10 factor days); Sensex 2 big days, 2 flagged by the model, 2 on volatility-factor days (9 factor days); Gold 8 big days, 1 flagged by the model; Silver 8 big days, 0 flagged by the model
